channel.title: Blocktape
channel.description: Blocktape reports crypto news: exchange and market moves, protocol upgrades, token launches, security incidents, regulation and enforcement across chains.

item.title: OCC leaves stablecoin rewards to case-by-case review
item.description: The OCC’s first GENIUS Act rule leaves exchanges able to seek approval for stablecoin rewards, while issuers remain barred from paying holders directly.

item.title: TRON Energy requests should specify amount, address and duration
item.description: A useful request names the receiving address, Energy target, timing and lock terms; TRON delegation assigns resources, while the staked TRX stays with its owner.

item.title: How to show cross-chain transfer status in an app
item.description: Show cross-chain transfers as separate origin, bridge and destination states, with chain-specific evidence, timestamps and a clear rule for when the app says complete.

item.title: Anza activates Alpenglow on Solana, targeting 150ms finality
item.description: Anza activated Alpenglow on Solana mainnet on Oct. 21, replacing TowerBFT and targeting finality in about 150 milliseconds, down from roughly 12.8 seconds.

item.title: Anza activates Alpenglow on Solana, targeting 150ms finality
item.description: Anza activated Alpenglow on Solana mainnet-beta on Oct. 21, replacing TowerBFT and targeting 150-millisecond transaction finality, down from 12.8 seconds.

item.title: SyncSwap pool types shape trades and liquidity risk
item.description: SyncSwap’s Classic, Stable and Aqua pools use different pricing curves, so pool choice affects swap slippage, liquidity exposure and how deposits are managed.

item.title: wormhole bridge transfer types: which fits your token?
item.description: Wormhole’s bridge routes tokens through wrapped transfers, native token transfers or CCTP; the right choice depends on token support, issuer control and destination chain.

item.title: JPMorgan brings JPM Coin to Ethereum for institutional clients
item.description: JPMorgan made JPM Coin available to institutional clients on Ethereum on Oct. 19, adding a second public network for bank deposits represented onchain.

item.title: Manta bridge offers two routes from Ethereum to Pacific
item.description: Manta bridge users can choose the canonical Ethereum route for direct deposits and withdrawals or an independent bridge for supported assets and alternate networks.

item.title: Across Repayment Depends on Where Relayers Request Funds
item.description: Across relayers can request repayment on the deposit chain or another supported chain; the choice affects liquidity costs and how funds are rebalanced.

item.title: JPMorgan brings JPM Coin to Ethereum for institutions
item.description: JPMorgan has made its dollar deposit token available to institutional clients on Ethereum, adding the mainnet to Base as a network for onchain payments.

item.title: Circle says 59% of H1 revenue went to USDC partners and costs
item.description: Circle said $819 million of its $1.4 billion in first-half 2026 revenue went to USDC partners and costs, as new stablecoin entrants promise broader revenue sharing.

item.title: Cross River Adds Ripple’s RLUSD to Core Banking Platform
item.description: Cross River adds Ripple’s RLUSD to its banking platform, giving fintechs one API for stablecoin payments alongside ACH, wires and real-time payments.

item.title: ASIC seeks feedback on Australian digital asset rules
item.description: ASIC has proposed licensing, custody, trading and financial standards for digital asset platforms, with the new framework due to begin on 8 April 2027.

item.title: Coinbase to power Marqeta stablecoin card programs
item.description: Marqeta says Coinbase will provide custody, fiat conversion and Base settlement for stablecoin-funded cards, while Marqeta handles issuing and processing.

item.title: How to replace an unsupported token in your wallet
item.description: If a wallet says a token is unsupported, check the network and contract first; import it for display, or follow the issuer’s migration process to replace it.

item.title: DOGE needs a bridge to trade in smart contracts
item.description: DOGE can enter smart-contract trading as a token on a compatible network; the bridge, liquidity and exit route determine what you can do and what risks you take.

item.title: Marqeta and Coinbase team up on stablecoin-backed cards
item.description: Coinbase will handle custody and fiat conversion for stablecoin-backed cards issued through Marqeta, with Base providing settlement for enterprise customers.

item.title: What to Do When a Crypto Bridge Quote Expires
item.description: An expired bridge quote is a stale offer, not proof that funds moved: check wallet activity, then reprice the same transfer before approving anything.

item.title: Why a mempool backlog delays your crypto transaction
item.description: A mempool backlog keeps a transaction out of a block until capacity and its fee make it competitive, while a wallet’s status may take time to update.
